'''Kowak''' was a tropical [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and the homeworld of the [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] species.

==Geology==
[[File:Mukmuk_crouch.png|thumb|left|180px|A red-skinned monkey-lizard]]
Kowak was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was completely covered in tropical rain forests. There were many animals that inhabited Kowak, but the dominant species on the planet were the [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]].

==History==
A group of [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]] zoologists once visited Kowak hoping to conduct a study on the [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] monkey-lizards. The zoologists noted that at first the monkey-lizards were apprehensive towards them, and seemed to be trying to keep to themselves. After about a week of being watched from afar with [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], the monkey-lizards began to wander into the group's camp, inspecting their equipment and looking around.<ref name="EGAS" />

[[File:KMonkeyL.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Monkey-lizards enter a camp]]
The zoologists eventually began to offer the creatures some of their food; that was when the Kowakians's cruel streak came out. They hid a snake in one of the zoologist's bags, destroyed their expensive equipment, ate all their food, played in their tents and even left barrels of water on top of branches, pouring their contents down on anyone who walked below. The zoologists had no choice but to leave the planet.<ref name="EGAS" /> Galactic universities still sent teams to catalogue the wildlife and research the planet's life for culinary and pharmaceutical uses over the centuries. <ref name="FLT" />

After the Clone Wars, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sono Molec/Legends|Molec]] of the Zyggerian Royal House developed the world into a base of operations for the [[Zygerrian Slavers Guild]]. The [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zyggerians]] also allowed other slaving organizations to operate on the planet including the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassian Slavers]], [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]], and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]].<ref name="FLT" />
